a1DrainHp.label: Prop Arrow spends HP
a1DrainHp.reason: Prop Arrows spend his HP while it is at 60% or more, which the healing from his Skill keeps up, so the hat's bonus is on when his Pyrotechnic Strike hits.

a4AffectedByPyro.label: Against Pyro-affected enemies
a4AffectedByPyro.reason: Depends on the enemy being affected by Pyro, a state of the enemy the planner does not know.

c2Stacks.label: Constellation 2 stacks
c2Stacks.reason: He gains a stack every 2 seconds on the field, so all three are up after 6 seconds and through the Charged Attacks and Skill he deals there.

propStacks.label: Prop Surplus stacks
propStacks.reason: His own Prop Arrows give the stacks, and his Skill is cast after them to spend the stacks.
